campaign.hero: Opaque standalone Grainient; eight sampled colors, curved horizon and procedural grain. Original image is fallback only. No superposition.
campaign.menu: Right staggered drawer, lilac/violet prelayers, paper index, real section links and social links.
campaign.controls: Borderless surfaces, dark spotlight area cards; retain keyboard focus outlines.
campaign.motion: 32s autonomous ribbon, no scroll binding, pauses on hover/focus/tap and offscreen. Reduced motion is static.

motionRevision.statement: Word scrub: fade .15 to 1, blur4px to0, .8 duration, .2 stagger, no smoothing, no rotation/offset; reduced motion fully visible.
motionRevision.faq: Joined plain pills; shared glide indicator, spring bounce .16, no intro, aria-pressed filters.
motionRevision.loading: Real image loading, 600ms wipe, timeout/error retry, text always available
motionRevision.shadows: None; latest user request overrides earlier shadow examples

narrative.overview:
The existing conference identity is the authority: a textured event poster expressed through monospaced typography, generous section rhythm, large numbers, and contrasting paper and charcoal surfaces. “Textured event poster” is a description of the implementation, not a newly approved brand slogan.

The multicolor grain and supplied photography carry the atmosphere. Controls remain readable and familiar, while the numbered areas and editorial rules connect practical information to the conference identity. Preserve this language when adding screens.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper, dark sections, and multicolor grain.
Large activity figures and numbered area cards.
Restrained floating ticket and contact controls.
dos: Do preserve the supplied imagery, typography, numbered areas, and alternating surfaces.
Do keep readable text protection over textured images.
Do preserve keyboard focus, native FAQ disclosure, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use the final cascade: legacy components, Live styles, then independent overrides.
donts: Don't replace the incumbent identity with a generic component-library theme.
Don't reinstate clipped names, hidden essential content, or tiny hero footer text.
Don't infer unimplemented visual states or a dark-mode switch from this palette.
